INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, sender_id, message, message_type, attachment_url, timestamp) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{sender}, #{content},
#{message_type} 'TEXT'
, #{attachment_url}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT cr.room_id FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_room_member m1 ON cr.room_id = m1.room_id JOIN chat_room_member m2 ON cr.room_id = m2.room_id WHERE cr.is_group = false AND m1.user_id = #{user1} AND m2.user_id = #{user2} GROUP BY cr.room_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2

SELECT cr.room_id, cr.is_group, cr.room_name, ( SELECT message FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = cr.room_id ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastMessage, ( SELECT timestamp FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = cr.room_id ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastMessageTime, ( SELECT message_type FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = cr.room_id ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS messageType, ( SELECT sender_id FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = cr.room_id ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastMessageSenderId, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.room_id = cr.room_id AND cm.message_id > COALESCE(m.last_read_message_id, 0) AND cm.sender_id != #{userId} ) AS unreadCount, ( SELECT COALESCE(mu.user_name, crm2.user_id) FROM chat_room_member crm2 LEFT JOIN member_user mu ON mu.user_id = crm2.user_id WHERE crm2.room_id = cr.room_id AND crm2.user_id != #{userId} LIMIT 1 ) AS opponentName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_member crm3 WHERE crm3.room_id = cr.room_id ) AS memberCount FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_room_member m ON cr.room_id = m.room_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lastMessageTime DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.room_id = crm.room_id AND cm.message_id > COALESCE(crm.last_read_message_id, 0) AND cm.sender_id != #{userId}) ), 0) FROM chat_room_member crm WHERE crm.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT cr.room_id, cr.is_group, cr.room_name, ( SELECT COALESCE(mu.user_name, crm2.user_id) FROM chat_room_member crm2 LEFT JOIN member_user mu ON mu.user_id = crm2.user_id WHERE crm2.room_id = cr.room_id AND crm2.user_id != #{userId} LIMIT 1 ) AS opponentName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_member crm3 WHERE crm3.room_id = cr.room_id ) AS memberCount FROM chat_room cr WHERE cr.room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT room_id FROM chat_room WHERE is_group = true AND room_name = 'guest_group' LIMIT 1
